description: Every controller-availability requirement mapped to its lifecycle boundary, expected observable result, implementing owner, and current evidence (add-controller-high-availability 1.1). status: verified = covered by a merged test; pending = not yet implemented or tested.

requirements.requirement: Two-replica default with explicit development mode
requirements.expected: chart defaults replicaCount 2; development values set 1 explicitly
requirements.evidence: internal/charttest TestRuntimeChartDefaults (2 replicas, election on), TestRuntimeChartDevelopment and TestDocumentedExamples/development.yaml (explicit 1, election on); TestLiveHelmInstall installs 2 ready replicas with a Lease holder

requirements.expected: preferred hostname anti-affinity weight 100; replicas may co-locate
requirements.evidence: rendered: TestRuntimeChartDefaults; deployed: TestLiveHelmAvailability placement (two workers, replicas apart) and co-location with one worker cordoned

requirements.requirement: Disruption protection matches the replica configuration
requirements.expected: minAvailable 1 PDB when replicas > 1; none for one replica
requirements.evidence: rendered: TestRuntimeChartDefaults/Development; deployed: TestLiveHelmAvailability second eviction refused (429), development values render no PDB and a drain proceeds

requirements.requirement: Rolling upgrades retain ready serving capacity
requirements.expected: maxUnavailable 0, maxSurge 1; replacement ready before retirement
requirements.evidence: rendered: TestRuntimeChartDefaults; deployed: TestLiveHelmAvailability rolling upgrade (min 2 ready) and a capacity-blocked surge that keeps both serving

requirements.expected: one Lease holder among simultaneous candidates; only the holder reconciles; a candidate without Lease access never leads
requirements.evidence: TestLiveLeaderElection (follower field manager on no written object), TestElectionTimings, TestBackgroundWorkersNeedLeadership

requirements.expected: leadership loss cancels work; stale writes conflict and re-resolve
requirements.evidence: TestLiveBoundedShutdown (cancel on Lease loss); TestDelayedFormerLeaderResolvesAgain, TestDelayedFormerLeaderCannotWithdrawTheNewRevision, TestDeleteRequiresTheListedObject (stale snapshot and delete preconditions); s3store TestStagePublishAndRecover, TestConflictingContentNeverOverwrites (same run identity)

requirements.requirement: Serving readiness is independent of leadership
requirements.expected: ready followers serve admission/downloads; readiness ignores leadership and engine health
requirements.evidence: downloads verified: TestLiveHelmInstall (both controller pods ready with one Lease holder; each download pod serves with no controller, readiness follows TLS); admission serving on followers waits for exception admission (3.1)

requirements.expected: every replica applies authoritative admission checks; no grant broadened by failover
requirements.evidence: availability 3.2; exception handlers wait on upstream Kyverno

requirements.requirement: Downloads do not depend on the elected pod
requirements.expected: any download-server replica serves the durable package with current authorization
requirements.evidence: TestLiveHelmInstall followerDownloads (charts group): controller scaled to 0; each download pod serves receipt-identical packages, applies revocation, audience, credential rotation, S3 outage (503) and namespace-UID isolation; no secrets logged

requirements.expected: successor recovers staged/committed packages with identity and expiry; loss before staging is CaptureLost
requirements.evidence: TestLiveAssessmentFaults (restart, single process); TestLiveLeaderHandoverRecovery (staged package committed by the successor with the original identity and bytes, outage not CaptureLost); TestLiveLeaderHandoverLoss (lost receipt: original commit, publishedAt and expiry under the committed retention; lost capture: CaptureLost, nothing committed, next run a new identity)

requirements.requirement: Replica-local state is reconstructible or explicitly unavailable
requirements.expected: local caches rebuilt or reported unavailable; watch gaps recorded
requirements.evidence: TestSuccessorWithUnverifiableContentKeepsPolicies, TestUnavailableContentKeepsAppliedPolicies, TestLocalContentRejectsTamperedFiles, TestRestartResumesSameCaptureWithoutContinuity, TestLiveEngineCapabilityRecovery; per-pod budgets and staging documented

requirements.expected: 45s application and 20s HTTP drain budgets within 60s grace; readiness fails while draining; no owned child processes
applied policies keep enforcing while the controller or its access is lost
requirements.evidence: TestLiveEngineCapabilityRecovery (permission loss retains enforcement, engine rollout)

requirements.expected: multi-node chart acceptance covering leader failure, eviction, upgrade, node loss
requirements.evidence: availability acceptance group TestLiveHelmAvailability (multi-node kind, packaged image): leader pod loss, evictions/PDB, rolling and constrained upgrades, node loss, controller outage, leader loss during S3 outage; staged-byte recovery via in-process TestLiveLeaderHandover*
